status.heading: Status page
status.admin_help: Publish node health and service updates
status.privacy_help: Only nodes you publish below appear. Visitors see your public labels, health and incident messages; node addresses, credentials and server details remain private.
status.collector_help: Checks run every minute using the panel scheduler. For the first sample, run:
status.no_components: No services have been published yet.
status.incident_help: Messages are visible to everyone who can access your status page. Write plain text without private details. Update an existing notice as the incident progresses.
status.overall_disruption: A service disruption is being reported
status.measurement_help: Availability is based on recorded daemon health checks, not individual game servers or an external uptime guarantee. Maintenance and missing samples are excluded. Checks older than three minutes show Unknown.

discord.heading: Discord roles
discord.admin_help: Keep Discord roles in sync with server ownership
discord.oauth_help: Enable Discord in OAuth settings so users can link their Discord account from Account settings. Existing linked accounts can still be synchronized.
discord.token_saved: Saved token; leave blank to keep it
discord.token_help: The token is encrypted and never shown. Use the bot token, not the OAuth client secret.
discord.setup_help: Invite your bot to the configured Discord server with Manage Roles permission. Its highest role must be above every role you want it to manage. Users must join that Discord server themselves. Enable Developer Mode in Discord to copy guild and role IDs.
discord.pause_help: Disabling pauses synchronization and keeps existing roles. To remove managed roles, disable or delete the rules while synchronization is still enabled, then wait for cleanup before disabling the bot.
discord.sync_help: Changes queue automatically and reconcile every five minutes. Run the panel scheduler and the queue worker, including the low queue. Rate limits and offline Discord requests retry automatically.
discord.rules_help: Each rule counts servers owned by the linked user that match both filters. Running and stopped servers count; suspended, installing and failed servers do not. A role is granted if any enabled rule for that role matches.
discord.ownership_help: Aquadactyl removes only roles it granted. Pre-existing roles are preserved. Managed roles are removed after unlinking Discord, account suspension, losing qualifying servers, or disabling/deleting a rule.
discord.guild_locked: Remove the role rules and allow managed grants to be cleaned up before changing the Discord server.
discord.credentials_required: A guild ID and bot token are required to enable synchronization.
discord.rule_limit: A maximum of 100 role rules is supported.
discord.saved: Discord settings saved. Eligible account changes have been queued when synchronization is enabled.
